conditions: Fresh app JVM, fresh private project/configuration directories. Bundled JUnit; no network needed for chapters A-D. Semantic/compiler workers warm progressively within this single session. No durations copied from control runs.
Captured in an ordinary development session with other development/browser work possible. The demo workspace and settings are isolated; the machine was not quiesced for a benchmark.

Actual pauses in this captured session: 1400 ms after state snapshots (600 ms for the empty file), 1600 ms after operation results, all outside operation measurement boundaries. Source input is automated in complete edits. Live compilation may finish during presentation pauses, so explicit Compile and Run may reuse its cache.
Automated input in the actual native application. Source entry and reading pauses are not measures of typing performance.
Successful Java Save. Unsaved changes were observed for 600 ms without execution. Save-to-result measurements include trigger scheduling and compilation; no inferred debounce duration is published.
Operation intervals play at 1×. This recording retains its actual scripted source entry and reading pauses; no timeline gaps were shortened.
Completion is sampled and painted on the Swing EDT. This is not a physical-display or browser millisecond-accuracy claim.
Spring Boot uses the explicit Maven spring-boot:run goal. Native Fast Run and Isolated Run retire this server when main returns.
curl is an external process, not a TurboJ terminal. Runner-reported durations in the output are separate from command-to-result elapsed time.
Dependencies and wrapper distribution were already downloaded during control runs. No MavenJ model existed for this fresh workspace.

Background Java HttpClient GET /hello until HTTP 200 with exact expected body. 25 ms between completed probes; timeout500ms. Measurement also includes final EDT paint checkpoint. This is not Spring's internal startup log duration.

Maven import is measured from Open through the settled model, including the configuration synchronization. The final publication reported model cacheHit=true, 39 dependencies, offline=false, native fast-path status PARTIAL. This is not a cold dependency-download measurement.
